name: Ijou Kakusei
source:
The main character is a young doctor who works at a small hospital. He's currently doing research on a disease called Nosfera, and has the ambition of eradicating it.

One day, however, a boy who was a patient in the hospital developed a new type of the same disease, and the symptoms caused him to ejaculate in agony due to the intense tingling of his penis. The new virus then infected the hospital staff as well as the main character who now can't control his sexual urges.

In this crazed state, he creates a secret drug, the "abnormal arousal", that causes more intense sexual symptoms in its victims: an innocent nurse, an arrogant genius female doctor, and a beautiful boy patient.
translation:
主人公是一名在小医院工作的年轻医生。他目前正在研究一种名为诺斯费拉的疾病，并立志将其根除。

然而某天，一名住院男孩感染了该疾病的新变种，症状导致他因阴茎剧烈刺痛而痛苦地射精。新病毒感染了医院的工作人员以及主人公，使他无法控制自己的性冲动。

在这种疯狂状态下，他制造了一种秘密药物“异常觉醒”，给受害者带来更强烈的性症状：天真的护士、傲慢的天才女医生和一个美少年患者。
